'''Emili Josep García Miramontes''' (born 11 January 1989) is an [[Andorra]]n international [[Association football|footballer]]. He currently plays as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]] for [[FC Pas de la Casa|Pas de la Casa]]. García made his international debut in 2008.

==International career==
García made his senior international debut on 4 June 2008 in a 2–1 friendly defeat to [[Azerbaijan national football team|Azerbaijan]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.national-football-teams.com/matches/report/12900/Andorra_Azerbaijan.html|title=Andorra vs. Azerbaijan (1:2)|website=national-football-teams.com|accessdate=26 January 2019}}</ref>
